name: @plusguard/spotlight
description: A large logo lit by the pointer: a dim, grainy wordmark that brightens in a soft circle around the cursor — or stays dark until the pointer finds it. From HTML attributes, for any SVG; light and dark, with or without Lenis. Zero dependencies. CSS included.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
